summary.text: Chris Lewey is the Democratic candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 82 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His campaign website identifies him as the founder and executive director of RAVEN Interpretive Programs and a resident of Fryeburg.

paragraphs.text: Lewey's campaign website says he lives in Fryeburg with his family and is the executive director and founder of RAVEN Interpretive Programs.
It states that he holds a B.A. in political science from the University of Southern Maine and a master's degree in environmental studies.
Lewey advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026, and faces Republican Caleb Ness in the general election.

His site lists the cost of living, practical housing solutions, rural health care and emergency services, roads and broadband, jobs and trades, and honest government among his priorities for Brownfield, Fryeburg, Hiram, Porter and Lovell.
